name: Affa
description: Affa was a terrestrial planet that housed great droid factories. Located in the Affa system in the Inner Rim Territories, it was situated in grid square M-13 and was located along the Shipwrights' Trace hyperspace route.
lead_paragraphs: Affa was a terrestrial planet that housed great droid factories. Located in the Affa system in the Inner Rim Territories, it was situated in grid square M-13 and was located along the Shipwrights' Trace hyperspace route.
Arakyd Industries's RA-7 protocol droids, including DK-RA-43, were manufactured in the factories, while parts for Cybot Galactica's 3PO-series protocol droid were also manufactured on the planet.
